sterling-crispin.medium: Digital and on-chain art: generative/code-based work, smart contracts, AI-related projects, and techno-sculpture
sterling-crispin.style: Conceptual, with generative art, machine intelligence and on-chain practice as the main body of work
sterling-crispin.reason: The collector excludes digital art, generative/code-based and AI art, and conceptual art, and Sterling Crispin's main body of work falls under those exclusions (on-chain generative art, smart contracts, AI, and conceptual practice).

derrick-velasquez.medium: Wall sculpture and installation, built from vinyl, wood, resin, and leaded glass, with some oil and collage on paper
derrick-velasquez.style: Non-representational, object-based work that sits between sculpture, installation, and abstraction, with a conceptual architectural framing
derrick-velasquez.reason: His main body of work is wall sculpture and installation, and the collector excludes sculpture that is object-based, installation, and abstract art, so he falls under the exclusions.

marcos-acosta.medium: Painting (canvas) and drawing/works on paper, with secondary engraving, sculpture, video and installation
marcos-acosta.style: Representational landscape painting (Córdoba sierras, Colorado and Southwest terrains) overlaid with abstract lines and curvilinear color forms; figurative, not non-representational
marcos-acosta.reason: His main body of work is landscape painting and drawing, which is not digital, sculpture, or conceptual/installation practice as the collector excludes, so it fits the preferences despite the abstract line overlays, which are secondary to the representational landscapes.
